name: Valkey Streams and Work Queues
description: Implement Valkey Stream primitives and queue mechanics: XADD for enqueue, XGROUP CREATE for consumer groups, XREADGROUP for consumption, XPENDING for stuck worker detection, XCLAIM for abandoned work reassignment, XACK for completion signaling. This lane owns stream mechanics only — durable correctness is owned by the Durable ACK Binding lane.
